description: LITS.jl, published by Energy-MAC, provides low-inertia transient power-system simulation as a Julia toolbox with retained version 0.4 examples. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The repository is archived and deprecated; its authors direct new features to PowerSimulationsDynamics. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: Its documented successor PowerSimulationsDynamics is explicitly covered by platform-sienna.
name: LITS.jl
notes: An identifiable archived predecessor, distinct from the current successor; useful for reproducing older simulations. Original discovery: A1/A1-0012. Geography and simulation-use tags are screening classifications.
